about: Independent open-source project. Not affiliated with OpenAI.
site.title: Aftertaste — library and notes
site.description: Save books, videos and games. Keep notes, search them and back up your library. ChatGPT recommendations are optional.
site.heroBody: A local library for books, videos and games, with your notes alongside them.
site.basicTitle: Save it. Add a note. Find it later.
site.basicBody: Find a book, manga or game in public catalogs. Add videos and articles by link. Keep written notes or voice recordings next to each item.
site.searchBody: Search titles, authors, note text and tags. Matching notes appear with their text, so you can open them directly.
site.tagsBody: Topics are detected on your device from titles, descriptions and notes. You can also add your own tags. No AI account needed.
site.backupBody: Download a complete backup with covers, audio, notes and context. A local recovery copy is made before app updates and data replacement.
site.gptTitle: Add recommendations when you want them.
site.gptBody: The full library works without ChatGPT. Connect your ChatGPT plan to get suggestions based on selected conversations, documents and written notes.
site.contextBody: Import and export chosen context, or connect a trusted local chat assistant. Nothing is collected in the background.
site.gptLimits: Sign-in does not reveal chat history. Eligible requests use your plan and its limits. No separate API key. AI recommendations require internet access.
site.downloadBody: No Aftertaste account or subscription. Choose your operating system.
site.unsigned: Unsigned preview. macOS builds are not notarized. Your system may warn or block first launch.
site.faqOfflineBody: Everything in the library: catalog search, manual entries, covers, notes, audio, note search, tags and backups. Personal AI recommendations are an optional extension. Local entries and notes work offline; public catalogs and remote covers need internet.
site.faqDataBody: On your computer. Backups include your context and notes, so keep them private. OAuth credentials are encrypted and excluded from backups. The library itself is not encrypted by Aftertaste.
site.faqVoiceBody: No. You can record, attach and play audio locally. Only written notes are used for ChatGPT recommendations.
